title: Planning lab: pump work methods
description: A fictional supported PWR model supplies public pump state and physical response parameters. Planning attaches explicit method durations, crew demands and a proposed work window. The demonstration does not model maintenance methods, isolation permits or lifting feasibility.
objectives: Reference exact live pump components while keeping work-duration assumptions in Planning.
Compare work sequences under shared crew capacity.

steps.title: Read the pump subjects
steps.instruction: This Run starts paused. Capture the public pump planning basis. Add explicit preparation, work and verification durations in Planning. Nominal pump flow and run-up time describe physical behavior, not a qualified maintenance method.

steps.title: Inspect the live plant
steps.instruction: Inspect the referenced pump and its public readings in World. A proposed work window does not change the plant. Use offered controls only for an explicitly chosen experiment, and retain actual command outcomes separately from method assumptions.
